target_customer: OCC, Fed and FDIC regulated banks, fintechs and payment platforms with financial crime compliance backlogs
problem: Banks and fintechs spend large headcount on AML investigations, KYC reviews and sanctions alert reviews that are repetitive and backlogged.
business_model: Enterprise software and managed services for AI agents that complete compliance investigations, sold to regulated institutions
product_category: AI agents for financial crime compliance (AML, KYC, sanctions)

founders.name: Will Lawrence
founders.background_notes: From the YC page. The YC page also names a co-founder Alex (no surname given), ex-Dropbox, in launch content, not clearly tied to Bretton, so not listed as a founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Applying LLM agents to regulated investigations needed integrations with bank systems plus audit and validation controls, but used foundation models available in 2023.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integration with bank case systems, audit trails and model validation create switching costs, but the core agent technique is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent compliance vendors and newer fintech compliance startups kept competing; no acquisition of Bretton found as of the sources.

market_need_then: Not separately sourced for 2023. The company later cites large manual review backlogs and customer results such as an 87% review time reduction, which are company-provided.

branding.name_origin: Bretton AI is an homage to Bretton Woods, the post-war monetary agreement that shaped the modern financial system; chosen at the February 2026 rebrand. The earlier name Greenlite has no sourced origin.
branding.domain_note: Now uses bretton.com, which replaced the earlier Greenlite site; acquisition details not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Institutional and trust focused, stressing audit-ready outputs

rebrands.why: CEO said the mission had expanded and the name needed to reflect it

brand_strength.rationale: Rebrand was covered by Business Wire, Fortune and others alongside the Series B, and the new name suits a bank audience, but the brand is young.

outcome_analysis: Bretton, founded as Greenlite AI in the Summer 2023 batch, rode the shift to LLM agents in regulated back offices. It raised a $15M Series A led by Greylock in May 2025 and a $75M Series B led by Sapphire in February 2026, when it rebranded. Named bank customers and company-reported savings support strong traction, though results are self-reported and well-funded rivals remain.
notes: A seed of about 4.8M in 2023 appears only in one third party profile, so it is not recorded as a round (unverified). Total raised around 90M is company-reported approximate. Competitor search found only current vendors, none dated near 2023, so list is empty. Education not found.
